milestones.name: Execution checkpoint and recovery
exit_criteria: Versioned project state exists
Task contracts define acceptance and recovery
Validator rejects malformed statuses and broken references
A clean handoff can resume from repository state

milestones.name: Evidence and progress integrity
exit_criteria: Run ledger records successes and failures with immutable evidence references
Progress claims resolve to evidence
Decision changes are dated and preserve prior rationale
CI rejects malformed control-plane state

milestones.name: Autonomous scheduling and recovery
exit_criteria: Scheduler selects only ready tasks within WIP limits
Repeated failures force a documented replan
Independent task branches and integration ownership are explicit

milestones.name: Evidence-based verification and integration
exit_criteria: Implementer self-review is recorded separately from automated test evidence
Trust-boundary changes include a security regression test and documented source-level threat review
Exact-head required CI passes and integration verifies full relevant regression suite and merge-base freshness
Self-review is never represented as independent peer review

milestones.name: CI enforcement
exit_criteria: Control-plane validator runs in deterministic CI
Claims and evidence references are checked mechanically
Deliberately malformed state is rejected in a negative test

milestones.name: Research integrity and repository baseline
exit_criteria: Research-only branch content is preserved and reviewed before pruning
Benchmark cohorts and thresholds are preregistered and immutable after start
Run artifacts and test counts are generated from source evidence

milestones.name: Package and single-command developer workflow
exit_criteria: Installable agent_native package
No import-time sys.path mutation
Unified CLI supports check/run/inspect/worker/audit
Existing deterministic test coverage is preserved or increased

milestones.name: Service-independent Gateway and declarative handlers
exit_criteria: Gateway resolves service by manifest/id, not a hard-coded demo
Declarative CRUD/job/event handlers are driven by IR
Write effects/capabilities are explicit and deny-by-default
A new service can be added without core changes

milestones.name: Real-agent capability evaluation
exit_criteria: Strong/medium/weak model classes are evaluated with preregistered stochastic cohorts
At least three representative tasks cover operation addition, compatible field addition, and tenant isolation
Proposal, validation, and plan share exact candidate hash
Failures and ineligible runs remain visible; no model claim exceeds evidence

milestones.name: Trusted development apply and rollback
exit_criteria: Agent writer principal cannot invoke apply
Separate controller requires explicit dev-only enablement and exact plan hash
Conformance and health checks gate atomic publication
Failure injection proves rollback to previous version

milestones.name: v0.1 hardening and release readiness
exit_criteria: F-01/F-03 and relevant security findings are resolved or explicitly scoped
Quickstart completes in a clean environment
Security model and limitations are documented
PRs are reviewable and release artifact is reproducible
